speak: Corporation's name.
Business number. 9 digits, 2 letters, and 4 digits.
Tax year-end. Year 4 digits. Month 2 digits. Day 2 digits.

Line 100. The following calculation totals $200,000 or less. Your active business income minus active business losses for the year. This includes your share of active business income and active business loss for the fiscal period of each partnership of which you were a member at any time in the year.
Line 105. The active business income for the tax year of each Canadian corporation with which you were associated in the year.
Line 110. Total. Line 100 plus line 105. Cannot exceed $200,000 under section 5201 of the regulations.
Adjusted business income from part 3, line 130.
Cost of manufacturing and processing capital from Part 5, line 150.
Cost of manufacturing and processing labour from Part 7, line 170.
Cost of capital from Part 4, line 140.
Cost of labour from Part 6, line 160.

Amount MP. Canadian manufacturing and processing profits. Line 130 multiplied by the result of line 150 plus line 170, divided by the result of line 140 plus line 160. Enter amount MP on line 200 in Part 9 of this schedule.

Line 120. Your active business income minus active business losses for the year. This includes your share of active business income and active business loss for the fiscal period of each partnership of which you were a member at any time in the year.
Amount 3A. Net resource income. Amount 8G from Part 8.
Amount 3B. Net resource adjustment per subsection 5203(3.1) of the regulations.
Amount 3C. Excess. Amount 3A minus amount 3B, if negative, enter 0. Instance 1.
Amount 3C. Instance 2.
Amount 3D. Refund interest under subsection 5203(4) of the regulations.
Line 125. Subtotal. Amount 3C plus amount 3D. Instance 1.
Line 125. Instance 2.
Line 130. Adjusted business income. ADJUBI. Line 120 minus line 125, if negative, enter 0. Enter this amount in parts 2, 10, and 14 as applicable.

Amount 4A. Gross cost of the following property that you owned at the end of the year and used at any time during the year. Depreciable assets eligible for capital cost allowance under Schedule II of the regulations.
Amount 4B. Gross cost of the following property that you owned at the end of the year and used at any time during the year. Timber limits and cutting rights other than a timber resource property.
Amount 4C. Gross cost of the following property that you owned at the end of the year and used at any time during the year. Immovable wood assets, Class 15.
Amount 4D. Gross cost of the following property that you owned at the end of the year and used at any time during the year. Industrial mineral mines.
Amount 4E. Gross cost of the following property that you owned at the end of the year and used at any time during the year. Capital expenditures for scientific research and experimental development.
Amount 4F. Gross cost of the following property that you owned at the end of the year and used at any time during the year. Part XVII property.
Subtotal. Total of amounts 4A to 4F.
Amount 4G. Total of amounts 4A to 4F multiplied by 10%.
Amount 4H. Rental cost for the use of property, which would be included in 4A to 4F if it were owned by you at the end of the year.
Amount 4I. Your share of the amounts that would be determined under amounts 4G and 4H for a partnership of which you were a member at any time in the year.
Line 140. Cost of capital. C. Add amounts 4G, 4H, and 4I. Enter this amount in parts 2 and 5, parts 10 and 11, and Part 14, as applicable.
Amount 5A. Cost of capital from line 140 in Part 4.

Amount 5B. The part of amount 5A that reflects the extent to which each property was used directly in qualified activities of the corporation during the year, or of a partnership during its fiscal period of which you were a member at any time in the year.
Line 150. Cost of manufacturing and processing capital. MC. Amount 5B multiplied by 100 divided by 85, cannot be more than amount 5A. Enter this amount in Part 2.
Amount 6A. Salaries and wages paid or payable to all employees for services performed during the year.
Amount 6B. Salaries and wages included in amount 6A that were included in the gross cost of property, Part 4, other than property manufactured and leased during the year to other persons.
Amount 6C. Salaries and wages included in amount 6A that were related to an active business carried on outside Canada.
Amount 6D. Salaries and wages included in amount 6A that were related to activities engaged in for the purpose of earning Canadian resource profits under section 5202 of the regulations.
Amount 6E. Salaries and wages included in amount 6A that were included in your Canadian or foreign exploration and development expenses.
Amount 6F. Subtotal. Total of amounts 6B to 6E. Instance 1.
Amount 6F. Instance 2.
Amount 6G. Subtotal. Amount 6A minus amount 6F.

Amount 6H. Salaries and wages referred to in amount 6A, minus the deductions in amount 6F for the fiscal period of a partnership of which you were a member at any time in the year. Corporation's share. Attach calculation.
Amount 6I. Subtotal. Salaries and wages. Amount 6G plus amount 6H.
Amount 6J. Amounts paid or payable during the year to non-employees for performing functions relating to management and administration.
Amount 6K. Amounts paid or payable during the year to non-employees for performing functions relating to scientific research and experimental development.
Amount 6L. Amounts paid or payable during the year to non-employees for performing functions relating to any service or function normally performed by employees of the corporation.
Amount 6M. Subtotal. Total of amounts 6J to 6L. Instance 1.
Amount 6M. Instance 2.
Amount 6N. Amounts included in amount 6M that were included in the gross cost of property, Part 4, other than property manufactured and leased during the year to other persons.
Amount 6O. Amounts included in amount 6M that were related to an active business carried on outside Canada.
Amount 6P. Amounts included in amount 6M that were related to activities engaged in for the purpose of earning Canadian resource profits under section 5202 of the regulations.
Amount 6Q. Amounts included in amount 6M that were included in your Canadian or foreign exploration and development expenses.
Amount 6R. Subtotal. Total of amounts 6N to 6Q. Instance 1.
Amount 6R. Instance 2.
Amount 6S. Subtotal. Amount 6M minus amount 6R.

Amount 6T. Amounts referred to in amount 6M, minus the deductions in amount 6R for the fiscal period of a partnership of which you were a member at any time in its year. Corporation's share. Attach calculation.
Amount 6U. Subtotal. Other payments. Amount 6S plus amount 6T.
Line 160. Cost of labour. L. Amount 6I plus amount 6U. Enter this amount in parts 2, 10, and 14, as applicable.

Amount 7A. Part of salaries and wages included in amount 6I that was paid or payable to employees for services directly engaged in qualified activities of the corporation during the year, or of a partnership during its fiscal period of which you were a member at any time in the year.

Amount 7B. Part of other payments included in amount 6U that was paid or payable to non-employees for performing functions that would be directly related to qualified activities of the corporation during the year, or of a partnership during its fiscal period of which you were a member at any time in the year, if they had been employees of the corporation or partnership.
Amount 7C. Total. Amount 7A plus amount 7B.
Line 170. Cost of manufacturing and processing labour. ML. Amount 7C multiplied by 100 divided by 75, cannot be more than line 160 in Part 6. Enter this amount in Part 2.
Amount 8A. Resource profits under section 1204 of the regulations for the year, including your share of resource profits as a member of a partnership under subsection 1206(3) of the regulations.
Amount 8B. Amounts included in income under section 59, other than amounts that were included in calculating resource profits, including your share of such amounts as a member of a partnership.
Amount 8C. Subtotal. Amount 8A plus amount 8B.
Amount 8D. Amounts deducted under section 65, other than amounts that were deducted in calculating resource profits.
Amount 8E. Income from the processing of foreign ore.
Amount 8F. Subtotal. Amount 8D plus amount 8E. Instance 1.
Amount 8F. Instance 2.
Amount 8G. Net resource income. Amount 8C minus amount 8F. Enter this at amount 3A.
Line 200. Canadian manufacturing and processing profits from Part 1 or Part 2, as applicable.
Amount 9A. Line 400, 405, 410, or 428 of the T2 return, whichever is the least.
Amount 9B. Subtotal. Line 200 minus amount 9A. Instance 1.
Amount 9B. Instance 2.
Amount 9C. Taxable income from line 360 of the T2 return.
Amount 9D. Line 400, 405, 410, or 428 of the T2 return, whichever is the least.
Amount 9E. Aggregate investment income from line 440 of the T2 return.
Foreign business income tax credit deductible from line 636 of the T2 return. Instance 1.
Amount 9F. Foreign business income tax credit deductible from line 636 of the T2 return multiplied by 4.
Amount 9G. Subtotal. Total of amounts 9D to 9F. Instance 1.
Amount 9G. Instance 2.
Amount 9H. Subtotal. Amount 9C minus amount 9G.
Lesser of amount 9B and amount 9H.
Amount 9I. Lesser of amount 9B and amount 9H multiplied by 13%.
Amount 9J. Amount 13L if you are claiming the deduction for generating electrical energy for sale or producing steam for sale.
Amount 9K. Amount from line 350 in Part 17 if you are claiming the ZETM deduction.
Amount 9L. Manufacturing and processing profits deduction and ZETM deduction. Total of amounts 9I to 9K. Enter this amount on line 616 of the T2 return.
Adjusted business income from Part 3, line 130.
Cost of manufacturing and processing capital from Part 11, line 205.
Cost of manufacturing and processing labour from Part 12, line 206.
Cost of capital from Part 4, line 140.
Cost of labour from Part 6, line 160.

Amount MPA. Canadian manufacturing and processing profits. Line 130 multiplied by the result of line 205 plus line 206, divided by the result of line 140 plus line 160. Enter amount MPA on line 210 in Part 13.
Amount 11A. Cost of capital from line 140 in Part 4.

Amount 11B. The part of amount 11A that reflects the extent to which each property was used directly in qualified activities of the corporation during the year, or of a partnership during its fiscal period of which you were a member at any time in the year.
Line 205. Cost of manufacturing and processing capital. MCA. Amount 11B multiplied by 100 divided by 85, cannot be more than amount 11A. Enter this amount in Part 10.

Amount 12A. Part of salaries and wages included in amount 6I that was paid or payable to employees for services directly engaged in qualified activities of the corporation during the year, or of a partnership during its fiscal period of which you were a member at any time in the year.

Amount 12B. Part of other payments included in amount 6U that was paid or payable to non-employees for performing functions that would be directly related to qualified activities of the corporation during the year, or of a partnership during its fiscal period of which you were a member at any time in the year, if they had been employees of the corporation or partnership.
Amount 12C. Total. Amount 12A plus amount 12B.
Line 206. Cost of manufacturing and processing labour. MLA. Amount 12C multiplied by 100 divided by 75, cannot be more than line 160 in Part 6. Enter this amount in Part 10.
Line 210. Canadian manufacturing and processing profits from Part 10.
Amount 13A. Line 400, 405, 410, or 428 of the T2 return, whichever is the least.
Amount 13B. Subtotal. Line 210 minus amount 13A. Instance 1.
Amount 13B. Instance 2.
Amount 13C. Taxable income from line 360 of the T2 return.
Amount 13D. Line 400, 405, 410, or 428 of the T2 return, whichever is the least.
Amount 13E. Aggregate investment income from line 440 of the T2 return.
Foreign business income tax credit deductible from line 636 of the T2 return. Instance 2.
Amount 13F. Foreign business income tax credit deductible from line 636 of the T2 return multiplied by 4.
Amount 13G. Subtotal. Total of amounts 13D to 13F. Instance 1.
Amount 13G. Instance 2.
Amount 13H. Subtotal. Amount 13C minus amount 13G.
Amount 13I. Lesser of amount 13B and amount 13H.
Amount 13J. Lesser of amount 9B and amount 9H.
Amount 13K. Subtotal. Amount 13I minus amount 13J. Instance 1.
Amount 13K. Instance 2.
Amount 13L. Manufacturing and processing profits deduction for generating electrical energy for sale or producing steam for sale. Amount 13K multiplied by 13%.
Amount 14A. ADJUBI from line 130 in Part 3.
ZETM cost of capital from Part 15, line 305.
ZETM cost of labour from Part 16, line 306.
Cost of capital from Part 4, line 140.
Cost of labour from Part 6, line 160.
Amount 14B. The result of line 305 plus line 306, divided by the result of line 140 plus line 160.
Amount 14C. ZETM profits. If amount 14B is 0.9 or greater, enter amount 14A, otherwise, multiply amount 14A by amount 14B. Enter this amount on line 310 in Part 17.

Line 305. ZETM cost of capital. MCB. The part of the cost of capital from line 140 in Part 4 that reflects the extent to which each property was used directly in qualified zero-emission technology manufacturing activities of the corporation during the year, or of a partnership during its fiscal period of which you were a member at any time in the year. Enter this amount in Part 14.

Amount 16A. Part of salaries and wages included in amount 6I that was paid or payable to employees for services directly engaged in qualified zero-emission technology manufacturing activities of the corporation during the year, or of a partnership during its fiscal period of which you were a member at any time in the year.

Amount 16B. Part of other payments included in amount 6U that was paid or payable to non-employees for performing functions that would be directly related to qualified zero-emission technology manufacturing activities of the corporation during the year, or of a partnership during its fiscal period of which you were a member at any time in the year, if they had been employees of the corporation or partnership.
Line 306. ZETM cost of labour. MLB. Amount 16A plus amount 16B. Enter this amount in Part 14.
Line 310. ZETM profits from Part 14.
Amount 17A. Line 120 from Part 3.
Amount 17B. Line 400, 405, 410, or 428 of the T2 return, whichever is the least.
Amount 17C. Subtotal. Amount 17A minus amount 17B. Instance 1.
Amount 17C. Instance 2.
Amount 17D. Taxable income from line 360 of the T2 return.
Amount 17E. Line 400, 405, 410, or 428 of the T2 return, whichever is the least.
Amount 17F. Aggregate investment income from line 440 of the T2 return.
Foreign business income tax credit deductible from line 636 of the T2 return. Instance 3.
Amount 17G. Foreign business income tax credit deductible from line 636 of the T2 return multiplied by 4.
Amount 17H. Subtotal. Total of amounts 17E to 17G. Instance 1.
Amount 17H. Instance 2.
Amount 17I. Subtotal. Amount 17D minus amount 17H.
Amount 17J. Line 310, amount 17C, or amount 17I, whichever is the least.
Amount 17L. Amount 17J multiplied by 7.5%.
Amount 17K. Amount 17E or the result of line 310 minus amount 17J, whichever is the least.
Amount 17M. Amount 17K multiplied by 4.5%.
Line 350. ZETM deduction. Amount 17L plus amount 17M.
